name: hap-oauth-mcp
description: Provides automated login and credential refreshing for Mingdao (HAP) using Playwright to extract session tokens and cookies. It enables AI tools to maintain authenticated access to Mingdao Cloud for automation scripts and MCP configurations.

rawRecord.description: Provides automated login and credential refreshing for Mingdao (HAP) using Playwright to extract session tokens and cookies. It enables AI tools to maintain authenticated access to Mingdao Cloud for automation scripts and MCP configurations.

output.description: The output file path to write the captured credentials (e.g., config/auth_config.py).

account.description: The account or email address for Mingdao login.

headless.description: Whether to run the Playwright browser in headless mode.

login-url.description: The specific login URL for the Mingdao server.
